_comment: Set 17 layer of the rule network, for replaying Set 17 games. Stage damage is unchanged from Riot's 16.1 notes through 18.6, so Set 17 shares Set 18's table; level 8 cost 60 XP from 7 until 18.2. Set 17 had god rounds at 2-4, 3-4 and 4-4 in place of carousels, and no Wisps.

overrides.statement: A lost player round costs the stage's base damage (2, 6, 7, 10, 12, 17 for stages 2 to 7) plus 1 for each enemy unit left alive.
4 gold buys 4 XP and every round gives 2 XP free. Level 8 cost 60 XP from 7 in Set 17.
From stage 2 each stage has seven rounds, with a god round at 2-4, 3-4 and 4-4 and a PvE round at x-7. Stages 3 and 4 hold most of the game's player rounds.
